### Borea v0.3.2

A fix release for v0.3.1. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- A mod pack is now called Compatible only when every mod it pins fits your game too. When a pinned mod needs a newer game, Borea does not install the pack and names that mod. When your game is newer than a pinned mod supports, the pack shows Untested, the pack page names the mod and the last game version it supports, and Borea asks before it installs. Before, a pack could show Compatible and then crash the game. Thanks to @renancamm for the report.
- Bold and italic text in descriptions and release notes is sharp now. Borea ships the real IBM Plex Sans Bold and Italic letters instead of a thickened or slanted copy of the regular ones. Thanks to @LaurensDeV for the report.
- The line under the buttons of a share page now reads: "Open in Borea" and "Install with Borea" work only when Borea is installed on this computer. Thanks to @LaurensDeV.
